title: RoutingPacket
description: Routing packet that directs a stream update to the correct recipient and documents the action chain

origin.description: Who/what created this routing packet (stream name or agent)

destination.description: Recipients who must act on this packet

subject.description: One-line subject line for this routing packet

urgency.description: How urgent action on this packet is

summary.description: What happened and why this packet exists

actionRequired.description: Exact action the destination should take

doNotStart.description: Items the recipient must NOT begin as a result of this packet

linkedStreamUpdatePacket.description: ID of the stream-update-packet this routing packet refers to

coordinatorApprovalRequired.description: True if no action should be taken until Coordinator explicitly approves
